tasks.short: Consult on discharge, patient care and clinical procedures

steps.what: Clarify the consultation question and review relevant patient care context
Provide consultation to health care providers and clarify clinical advice

tasks.design: Keep contextual review and consultation with the specialist. Use existing {OTHER} clinical-record and procedure access; no automated answer is presented as specialist advice.
tasks.previous_blocker: The right advice depends on details that may be absent from the original question.
tasks.enabler_now: Shared records can support review but do not remove specialist interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling discharge constraints, patient preferences and clinical risk.
tasks.human_edge: Ask the missing question and explain the limits of advice to the requesting provider.
tasks.altitude: Consultation scope and responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.task: Improve the clinical question in a specialist referral

evidence.claim: Contextual specialist consultation includes clinical interpretation and dialogue that a record lookup does not replace.

assumptions: Boundary includes specialist review and advice, not the requesting provider's treatment or a separate consultation note.

The requesting provider supplies the question; treating professionals supply dated patient findings through routine care outside this boundary with unchanged effort. Specialist clarification and reconciliation remain in s1; missing data trigger direct clarification, not assumed structured completeness.
Test native clinical-record views first; no new tool, automatic triage or care recommendation is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the process is unchanged.
Overlap with a general collaboration or recommendation task must be assigned once in a roll-up.
unknowns: Local consultation scope and information access
research_questions: Is delay mainly caused by missing context, unavailable staff or unresolved clinical judgement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, net=0. Straightforward advice and complex discharge consultation both retain review and discussion; no separate drafting baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify training needs and teach nursing students or medical staff

steps.what: Identify training needs from observed practice and learner discussion
Prepare training exercises and verify their clinical meaning

loop.purpose: Draft exercises for identified learning objectives
loop.input: Specialist-selected procedure passages, objectives and learner level
loop.output: Draft exercises, expected answers and passage references
loop.check: Specialist checks clinical meaning, sequence, contraindications, omissions and whether expected answers follow the supplied procedure
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unverifiable items are removed or written manually before use
loop.why_not_simpler: Native reusable materials come first; adapting wording and scenarios to an objective needs language judgement

steps.what: Conduct training sessions and assess learner understanding

tasks.design: Reuse native training materials in {DOCS} first and draft only missing exercises from specialist-selected procedure passages. The specialist verifies the exact material before using it and retains live teaching and assessment time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Adapting exercises to learner needs consumes composition time.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded drafting loop can prepare source-linked exercises without deciding learning needs.
tasks.still_hard: Detecting unsafe understanding and judging practical competence.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt teaching to responses and demonstrate a procedure safely.

ambition.what: Offer a short tailored practice exercise to staff returning to an unfamiliar procedure

tasks.altitude: Less exercise composition; teaching and competence decisions remain with qualified staff.

reach.learn: Learning objectives, feedback and limits of competence assessment

evidence.claim: Drafting exercises from selected text is plausible, but clinical fidelity and time gains require local evaluation.

assumptions: Boundary covers needs assessment, exercise preparation and delivery. This is an alternative view of teaching work in the educational-program task, not additive savings.

The specialist produces objectives, learner level, procedure version and exact source passages in s1, including capture time. Incomplete or outdated material returns to manual preparation; no clean source packet is assumed free.
Check native document templates and existing exercise banks before using a model. No identifiable patient examples are required.
The specialist's final decision to use the exact exercises is counted at the start of s3; changes require renewed review before presentation.
The 20 percent preparation share is an E1 scenario, not measured staff time.
unknowns: Existing reusable materials, teaching remit and observed preparation share
research_questions: Does full review preserve clinical meaning while reducing exercise preparation time?

already_counted.description: Needs assessment and live teaching, including final release review, remain.
Exercise review and manual corrections remain.

incremental.description: Specialist updates source selections and audits exercise fidelity after changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact exercise text, expected answers, source procedure version and learner level checked before teaching; any edit voids release

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=90, gross=10 less three upkeep hours gives net=7. High assumes exercise preparation halves; low assumes review leaves only enough gain to offset upkeep. Needs assessment and teaching remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate educational programs and conduct clinical in-service sessions

steps.what: Coordinate educational programs, participants, rooms and session times
Conduct in-service training and check understanding of clinical procedures

tasks.design: Configure native session scheduling and enrolment in {LMS} with {CALENDAR} availability. The specialist still enters the session requirements, resolves conflicts and confirms the plan; live clinical teaching keeps its full time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated availability messages can slow session coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing scheduling and enrolment functions can consolidate replies without deciding safe staffing coverage.
tasks.still_hard: Finding attendance time without weakening clinical cover and teaching practical skills.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve attendance priorities and check whether staff understand the procedure.
tasks.altitude: Less coordination messaging; staffing and teaching authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Help plan an in-service session around care coverage
reach.learn: Enrolment controls and escalation of coverage conflicts

evidence.claim: Native scheduling and enrolment can reduce repeated coordination while leaving attendance decisions and teaching human.

assumptions: Boundary starts with an approved learning programme and materials. Their clinical development remains outside and unchanged; teaching overlap with the training-needs task must be assigned once.

In retained s1 time the specialist captures topic, material version, duration, trainer, eligible group, capacity and candidate times. Staff and room owners supply availability through their existing calendars, with unchanged effort; staff without reliable entries are contacted manually within retained coordination time.
Staffing permission is confirmed through the existing manager route; scheduling availability never counts as safe-cover approval. That manager work remains unchanged outside the specialist baseline.
Test native enrolment and calendar functions before custom automation. The specialist confirms internal entries; no automatic clinical certification or staff-risk scoring is introduced.
The 25 percent coordination share is an E1 test scenario.
unknowns: Calendar reliability, native scheduling access and actual coordination time
research_questions: Does consolidated scheduling reduce repeated messages after counting setup, missing replies and coverage checks?

already_counted.description: Session requirement capture, conflicts and final coordination remain.
Training delivery and understanding checks remain.

incremental.description: Specialist checks enrolment rules, access and recurring calendar issues.
Learning-system administrator maintains scheduling permissions and configuration.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=90, gross=10 less two focal upkeep hours gives net=8. High assumes coordination time falls 40 percent; low assumes manual availability and cover checks absorb the potential gain beyond upkeep. Teaching retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Make clinical recommendations to providers, patients and organisations

steps.what: Assess clinical context and formulate recommendations within specialty scope
Communicate clinical recommendations and explain conditions and uncertainty

tasks.design: Keep formulation and explanation of clinical recommendations with the specialist using the {OTHER} clinical record and current guidance in {DOCS}. A record-answering capability is not evidence that recommendations can be delegated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recommendation quality depends on professional interpretation and recipient context.
tasks.enabler_now: Record-question tools exist, but the digest does not establish that they replace this clinical judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining uncertainty and checking that the recipient understands conditions and limits.
tasks.human_edge: Choose defensible advice, identify when another profession must decide and answer follow-up questions.
tasks.altitude: No change to recommendation, prescribing or insurer decision rights.

reach.task: Prepare a clear request for specialist recommendations
reach.learn: Clinical context, scope boundaries and communication of uncertainty

evidence.claim: Delphyr offers clinician questions on the record; this capability does not establish autonomous clinical recommendations.
Formulating and communicating a contextual clinical recommendation remains professional judgement in this design.

assumptions: Boundary covers formulation and communication, not a separate administrative letter or downstream treatment. Overlap with consultation is allocated once.

Treating professionals produce patient identifiers, dated findings and care context during existing care outside this boundary, unchanged. The specialist reconciles relevance in s1 and obtains missing information manually; no complete structured recommendation input is presumed.
Actual specialty authority and recipient access are verified locally; the US occupation label grants no additional rights.
Test native clinical-record and guidance access first. No automated recommendation, clinical ranking or external message is introduced.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new tool or data capture is introduced.
unknowns: Local scope, recipient mix and whether letter composition is separately measured
research_questions: Which recommendation cases include a distinct clerical step that can be measured separately from clinical judgement?

already_counted.description: Clinical reasoning and recommendation discussion remain.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0. Whether advice is simple or uncertain, this design changes neither assessment nor explanation and claims no hypothetical letter saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Clinical consultation and recommendations retain full professional judgement; preparation and scheduling support can reduce a limited part of teaching work.
reach: Help registered nurses formulate better consultation questions
Facilitate targeted procedure training within verified authority
role.ambitious_version: Provide more tailored practice exercises while retaining live teaching, contextual clinical advice and existing decision rights.
